operational_simulation.organization_and_actor: Brazilian public education network; pedagogical coordinator, teacher, and learner-support team
processes: rank remedial learning activities after formative assessment
prioritize tutoring or learner-support interventions under limited capacity
rank vocational or enrichment pathways against student goals and prerequisites
operational_simulation.deterministic_and_statistical_baseline: BNCC skill matrices, mastery thresholds, prerequisite rules, teacher-defined pathways, queue priority, capacity constraints, and simple score-based ordering
operational_simulation.remaining_opportunity: No distinct opportunity remained beyond existing adaptive-learning products, configured mastery paths, and the repository's existing persistence and accessibility cases.

training_data.observation_unit: One learner-candidate intervention pair at a defined instructional decision point
training_data.input_data: Assessment results available before recommendation, skill and prerequisite mappings, learner goals, prior completed activities, accessibility constraints, intervention metadata, and current capacity
training_data.target_or_reward: Subsequent mastery improvement, completion, or teacher-confirmed usefulness attributable enough to compare candidate ordering
training_data.label_source: Later assessments, activity completion, and teacher review; causal attribution is not guaranteed
training_data.prediction_time: After a formative assessment or support trigger and before the activity or intervention is assigned
training_data.expected_volume: Unknown; must be measured per network, subject, grade, and intervention catalog
training_data.class_balance: Unknown; positive learning gains and teacher approvals may be uneven across subjects and learner groups
training_data.historical_coverage: Assumed to vary materially across schools, platforms, grade levels, and periods
training_data.train_validation_split: Time-based and school-aware split, with protected holdouts by cohort and intervention catalog version
training_data.leakage_risks: Using post-assignment engagement, later assessment results, teacher overrides, final pathway placement, or intervention completion fields as prediction-time inputs
training_data.representativeness_risks: Differences in connectivity, disability support, school resources, teacher practice, curriculum sequencing, region, and learner socioeconomic context
training_data.feedback_loop: Teacher accept, reject, or reorder actions plus later learning outcomes; monitor whether recommendations narrow exposure to diverse materials
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: Educational records require purpose limitation, minimization, access control, auditing, and prohibition of autonomous high-impact educational decisions
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: Use teacher-configured mastery paths, prerequisite rules, transparent score bands, and randomized or prospectively designed pilots before learned ranking

portfolio_coherence.material_differentiation: Not established. Personalized activity ranking overlaps existing adaptive-learning and mastery-path products, while support prioritization overlaps EDU-001.
